noShortcutsRegisteredForContext: Enweghị ụzọ mkpirisi edebanyere aha maka ọnọdụ a.
aboutIntro: Ụzọ mkpirisi kiibọọdụ, nkuzi, obodo na ihe ndị ọzọ iji nyere gị aka ịmụta na ito HAX.
haxDescription: HAX bụ usoro ide ihe sitere na web, emebere maka mbipụta ọdịnaya enwere ike ịnweta ma kewaa n'akụkụ n'ọtụtụ gburugburu nnyefe.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Edebanyere aha n'otu ebe na HAXcms ma egosi ya site n'ọnọdụ na-arụ ọrụ. Njikọ na-eji Ctrl+Shift+[Igodo]; na ndezi, ịpịnye ihe mmalite markdown wee pịa oghere na-agbanwe ngọngọ ahụ. Pịnye {slash} na ngọngọ ederede efu iji mepee Ọchụchọ n'ahịrị.
tutorialsAndHowTo: Nkuzi na otu esi eme ya
tutorialsDescription: Bido site n'ọrụ edupụtara, wee gaa na nkuzi nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ.
apiLinksDescription: HAXcms nwere ike ibipụta ibe n'ụdị igwe na-aghọta ka ngwaọrụ LLM wee gụọ ma hazie ọdịnaya gị na-enweghị nhicha dị ukwuu.
apiLinksFormats: Tinye {formats} na URL ibe iji rịọ mmepụta ibe ọzọ.
apiLinksLlms: Jiri {llms} dị ka ndekọ ụdị na-eche ihu maka saịtị a, nwere njikọ na akụrụngwa igwe na-agụ ndị bụ isi.
apiLinksPair: Jikọọ {siteJson} (usoro) na {searchIndex} (nweta) maka usoro ọrụ AI siri ike karị.
